reason: The inference that the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays make S_{P,Q} a Hilbert space is unsupported. That registered axiom supplies the level-one/coordinate-sum inner-product displays (and deliberately does not provision the amplified norm claim); an inner product yields only a pre-Hilbert space, not completeness. A concrete model of the asserted inference is c_00 with its usual l2 inner product: it satisfies an inner-product display but is not complete. To obtain the required conclusion one must additionally establish that S_{P,Q} is complete, e.g. as the closed range of a bounded idempotent compression on the complete ambient A, or cite an allowed norm-equivalence plus closedness result. Neither such fact is stated in this leaf, declared as a dependency, or supplied by the shard's four permitted validated inputs. Thus Banachness of the column target, and hence the Neumann step, has a real gap.
